globalAttributes.name: data-tooltip-media
globalAttributes.description: Specifies the video source used by the media tooltip. Required for automatic initialization.

globalAttributes.name: data-tooltip-position
globalAttributes.description: Sets the preferred position of the tooltip. Defaults to top.

globalAttributes.name: data-tooltip-width
globalAttributes.description: Sets the tooltip video width in pixels. Must be a positive number. Defaults to 300.

globalAttributes.name: data-tooltip-offset
globalAttributes.description: Sets the distance between the trigger and tooltip in pixels. Must be a non-negative number. Defaults to 8.

globalAttributes.name: data-tooltip-trigger
globalAttributes.description: Sets how the tooltip is activated. Defaults to hover.

globalAttributes.name: data-tooltip-autoplay
globalAttributes.description: Controls automatic video playback. Defaults to true unless reduced motion is preferred.

globalAttributes.name: data-tooltip-loop
globalAttributes.description: Controls whether the video repeats. Defaults to true.

globalAttributes.name: data-tooltip-muted
globalAttributes.description: Controls whether the video is muted. Defaults to true.

globalAttributes.name: data-tooltip-class
globalAttributes.description: Adds one or more custom CSS classes to the tooltip container.

values.name: top
values.description: Position the tooltip above the trigger.

values.name: bottom
values.description: Position the tooltip below the trigger.

values.name: left
values.description: Position the tooltip to the left of the trigger.

values.name: right
values.description: Position the tooltip to the right of the trigger.

values.name: hover
values.description: Activate the tooltip on hover. Touch and pen interactions are also supported.
